freeze_rule: Commit protocol, wrapper, tests and complete source/tool identities before any new calibration or holdout execution. No post-observation parameter or candidate change. Integration regression fixtures are separate and not these holdout workloads.
unseen_scope: The declared future batch sizes and calls are frozen. Training uses seed 43; future workload observations at seeds 173 and 174 are withheld until actual episodes. Input shapes are disclosed equally, and calibration at those shapes is permitted; this is not hidden-shape generalization.
same_information: All eight arms receive one identical real candidate bank, transition/proof/build costs, future workload inputs and only their own completed execution observations. No arm sees future measured times. Exact advisory/result cache capacity is zero for all arms. NDU and exact-Q32 DP evaluate the same finite contract; graph serialization/transport differences remain charged.
candidate_scope: Actual baseline, independently proved guarded reduction and independently proved guarded-plus-narrowing; rejected unguarded body is retained as a negative control. Every changed state is freshly proposed, proved, compiled and executed from hash-matched sealed bytes.
strong_static_scope: fixed-best-plan selects the complete calibrated minimum-cost plan in this identical HIA candidate set. This is not a claim of beating strongest C/C++/Rust/LTO/PGO code or of universal instruction optimality.
cost_scope: Report actual wrapper admission, source snapshot, calibration, proof, compilation, decisions, switching, loader, work, per-arm evidence, native start/stop and final graph serialization. Charge historical original empty-target native build outer envelope to each standalone native arm, while also reporting already-built marginal costs. Persistent evidence storage, toolchain/dependency acquisition and human work remain explicitly unknown or retained; they are never replaced by zero.
acceptance: All episodes and independent checks must complete under their actual budgets. Preserve every failed/abstained sample. Report cold-start and observed two-episode amortization separately. Measured-scope net gain requires both native arms to beat fixed-best-plan, exact Q32 DP and light control on standalone total cost; broader lifetime/productivity/performance advantage remains unproved while exclusions or unknowns exist. No optional stopping or rerun after observations.
